name: Archetípus azonosító
notes: Separate B02 projections are not silently joined.

name: Baseline állapot
notes: P1 accepts only S0.

name: Alapterület
notes: Not sufficient to reconstruct building physics.

name: Fűtött alapterület
notes: Missing value remains Q.

name: Épülettípus
definition: Explicit building type or B02 archetype category
notes: ASS/modelled proxy is not OBS building truth.

name: Építési időszak
notes: No default U-value is inferred.

name: Burok típusmezők
definition: Wall roof floor and window type inputs
notes: Required only when a later envelope method supports them.

name: Baseline éves térfűtési igény
notes: Modelled baseline input; not before/after retrofit measurement.

name: Baseline csúcshőigény
notes: No national peak value is inferred from annual energy.

name: Baseline előremenő hőmérséklet
notes: Regulatory reference temperature is not an observed building value.

name: Baseline éves HMV igény
notes: Envelope interventions do not silently reduce DHW.

name: Baseline HMV csúcsigény
notes: Kept separate for B05 handoff.

name: Éves redukciós faktor
notes: SCN fixture only until source-native/calibrated evidence exists.

name: Csúcsterhelési redukciós faktor
notes: Independent from annual factor; never substituted.

name: Post-retrofit előremenő hőmérséklet
notes: No automatic W35/W45/W55 conversion.

name: Post-retrofit éves térfűtési igény
notes: Output is Q when any required intervention factor or applicability is Q.

name: Post-retrofit csúcshőigény
notes: Independent from annual output.

name: S1 kapu
definition: Whether completion evidence satisfies S1 transition
notes: No automatic S1 promotion from a catalog option.

name: B05 design-point handoff
definition: Post-retrofit peak heat and explicit supply/DHW interface
notes: Hourly B05 demand profile remains a separate explicit contract.

name: Tervezési külső hőmérséklet
definition: Explicit design outdoor temperature for a calculation case
notes: No national Hungarian value is invented; meteorological observation
column11: policy reference and scenario stress remain distinct.

name: Tervezési belső hőmérséklet
notes: Must be explicit for every design calculation.

name: Transzmissziós hőveszteségi tényező
definition: Sum of U times area times explicit boundary correction
notes: Missing U or area is Q; no floor-area-only reconstruction.

name: Szellőzési hőveszteségi tényező
definition: Explicit volume and ACH or airflow with heat-recovery and air-capacity inputs
notes: No hidden generic ACH or zero ventilation default.

name: Hőhidak hőveszteségi tényezője
definition: Explicit thermal-bridge contribution to design heat loss
notes: Missing mandatory thermal-bridge method remains Q.

name: Baseline tervezési hőterhelés
definition: Direct physical baseline design heat load from envelope plus ventilation
notes: Never derived from annual energy or installed equipment capacity.

name: Post-retrofit tervezési hőterhelés
definition: Recomputed design heat load after explicit physical state change
notes: Uses the post-state geometry

name: Csúcshőterhelés-csökkenés
definition: Baseline design heat load minus post design heat load
notes: Direct physical derivation; not P2 annual effect factor.

name: Szükséges tervezési előremenő hőmérséklet
definition: Emitter-equation result only with explicit nominal output and operating points
notes: No numeric household result until emitter evidence and return temperatures are available.
